title: THALIA: Typed Harness with Analytical Lexical-Integrated Architecture
description: THALIA is an executable research harness for long-context memory systems. It combines typed stage contracts, inspectable context selection, evidence-preserving episodic state, lexical-first retrieval, and bounded compiler search with source-bound evaluation and reproducible artifact checks. The deterministic results are finite diagnostic evidence; model-quality, integrity-advantage, and production-readiness claims remain separately gated.

methods.name: Five-stage typed pipeline: Inspector, Retriever, Reasoner, Memory Gate, Compiler
methods.description: Implements a long-context memory harness where each stage has a typed input/output contract, runnable implementation, evidence trace and declared scope.
methods.evidence: We implement a 5-stage pipeline that makes retrieval, context narrowing, answer generation, memory mutation, and configuration search explicit.

methods.name: Offline lexical/hashing retrieval fused by weighted reciprocal-rank fusion
methods.description: The deterministic core uses BM25/grep, hashing-based retrieval, weighted RRF, real SQLite state and bounded MIPRO/GEPA-style configuration search without network calls.
methods.evidence: The core is deterministic and offline: BM25/grep, hashing-based retrieval, weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, real SQLite state, and bounded MIPRO/GEPA-style search run without network calls or mocks.

methods.name: Episodic-first memory: raw episodes appended before gated consolidation
methods.description: The Memory Gate appends each raw turn to state before evaluating a derived memory delta, preserving source material for auditing.
methods.evidence: The runtime appends raw episodes before evaluating gated consolidation, keeps the transcript outside the model prompt, and returns cited evidence with the answer.

methods.name: Tiered evaluation on LongMemEval-style, local, and LongMemEval_S slices
methods.description: Evaluates a fixed 6-example diagnostic set, a 24-example local comparison with gemma3:4b, an external LongMemEval_S transfer slice, and a 40-question bottleneck slice.
methods.evidence: We evaluate the harness in separate evidence tiers. On the fixed 6-example LongMemEval-style diagnostic set, the default configuration reaches composite 0.621

methods.name: Injection and poisoning probes of cited excerpts
methods.description: Recorded injection probes test whether cited excerpts contain a supplied gold value and measure a poisoning effect, as negative controls.
methods.evidence: Under the recorded injection probes, THALIA’s cited excerpts contain the supplied gold value on 30 of 30 probes

key_findings: On the fixed 6-example diagnostic set the default configuration reaches composite 0.621 (token-F1 0.477, citation-support proxy 0.830, efficiency 0.854).
The 8-candidate compiler search ties on this easy set, so configuration improvement is unobserved; its main output is an auditable trace with a tie rule.
Replacing the extractive Reasoner with gemma3:4b changed mean token-F1 from 0.587 to 0.540 in the 24-example comparison, with an interval spanning zero.
In the 40-question bottleneck slice, ranking recall is 1.00 but Inspector recall is 0.60; an adaptive context policy raised neural token-F1 from 0.086 to 0.171.
The author reports operational provenance as the clearest advantage, with equality on poisoning and no general answer-quality advantage.
key_findings_evidence: the default configuration reaches composite 0.621 (answer token-F1 0.477, citation-support proxy 0.830, efficiency 0.854).
The 8-candidate compiler search ties on this easy set. Its primary finding is a complete, auditable trace with a deterministic tie rule; configuration improvement is unobserved on this distribution.
replacing the extractive Reasoner with gemma3:4b changes mean token-F1 from 0.587 to 0.540 (paired difference -0.046, 95% descriptive interval [-0.161, 0.067]).
In the 40-question bottleneck slice, ranking recall is 1.00 while Inspector recall is 0.60; an adaptive context policy changes neural answer token-F1 from 0.086 to 0.171
The current evidence identifies operational provenance as the clearest advantage while showing equality on poisoning and no general answer-quality advantage.

summary_provenance.method: Evidence-grounded extraction from full_text.md: every method and finding carries a verbatim quote from the paper text, mechanically verified to occur in full_text.md (whitespace/ligature-normalized) before merge.
summary_provenance.notes: Small, author-run evaluation tiers (6, 24 and 40 examples plus a LongMemEval_S slice); the author explicitly limits claims to method integrity and failure localization, treats token-F1 and citation overlap as operational diagnostics, and leaves RQ4 (expert quality, production acceptance) as unmet.
